question: What is total marketing spend?
semantic_sql: SELECT SUM(spend_gbp) AS spend_gbp FROM MarketingMonthlyOverview;

question: What are overall CTR and CPC?
semantic_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS ctr_pct, SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cpc_gbp FROM MarketingMonthlyOverview;
direct_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS ctr_pct, SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cpc_gbp FROM "fab_ent"."raw_marts"."mart_marketing__monthly_overview";

question: Which five campaigns have the highest net ROAS?
semantic_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, SUM(attributed_net_revenue_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_gbp), 0) AS net_roas FROM MarketingCampaignSummary GROUP BY campaign_id, campaign_name ORDER BY net_roas DESC NULLS LAST, campaign_id ASC LIMIT 5;
direct_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, SUM(attributed_net_revenue_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_gbp), 0) AS net_roas FROM "fab_ent"."raw_marts"."mart_marketing__campaign_summary" GROUP BY campaign_id, campaign_name ORDER BY net_roas DESC NULLS LAST, campaign_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Which campaigns spent money without eligible attributed orders?
semantic_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, spend_gbp, attributed_orders, flag_spend_without_eligible_attributed_orders FROM MarketingCampaignSummary WHERE spend_gbp > 0 AND attributed_orders = 0 ORDER BY campaign_id ASC;
direct_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, spend_gbp, attributed_orders, flag_spend_without_eligible_attributed_orders FROM "fab_ent"."raw_marts"."mart_marketing__campaign_summary" WHERE spend_gbp > 0 AND attributed_orders = 0 ORDER BY campaign_id ASC;

question: Which campaigns exceeded their lifetime budget?
semantic_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, spend_gbp, lifetime_budget_gbp, 100.0 * spend_gbp / NULLIF(lifetime_budget_gbp, 0) AS budget_utilisation_pct, flag_budget_overspend FROM MarketingCampaignSummary WHERE spend_gbp > lifetime_budget_gbp ORDER BY budget_utilisation_pct DESC NULLS LAST, campaign_id ASC;
direct_sql: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, spend_gbp, lifetime_budget_gbp, 100.0 * spend_gbp / NULLIF(lifetime_budget_gbp, 0) AS budget_utilisation_pct, flag_budget_overspend FROM "fab_ent"."raw_marts"."mart_marketing__campaign_summary" WHERE spend_gbp > lifetime_budget_gbp ORDER BY budget_utilisation_pct DESC NULLS LAST, campaign_id ASC;

question: What is monthly spend and net revenue?
semantic_sql: SELECT CAST(reporting_month AS VARCHAR) AS reporting_month, SUM(spend_gbp) AS spend_gbp, SUM(net_revenue_gbp) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM MarketingMonthlyOverview GROUP BY reporting_month ORDER BY reporting_month ASC;
direct_sql: SELECT CAST(reporting_month AS VARCHAR) AS reporting_month, SUM(spend_gbp) AS spend_gbp, SUM(net_revenue_gbp) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM "fab_ent"."raw_marts"."mart_marketing__monthly_overview" GROUP BY reporting_month ORDER BY reporting_month ASC;

question: How does performance compare by channel?
semantic_sql:
SELECT marketing_channel, cost_coverage, SUM(spend_gbp) AS spend_gbp, SUM(valid_sessions) AS valid_sessions, SUM(attributed_orders) AS attributed_orders, SUM(net_revenue_gbp) AS net_revenue_gbp,
100.0 * SUM(clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS ctr_pct,
SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cpc_gbp,
CASE WHEN cost_coverage = 'platform_media_only' THEN 100.0 * SUM(attributed_orders) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_sessions), 0) END AS conversion_rate_pct,
CASE WHEN cost_coverage = 'platform_media_only' THEN SUM(attributed_net_revenue_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_gbp), 0) END AS net_roas,
CASE WHEN cost_coverage = 'platform_media_only' THEN SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_first_observed_acquisitions), 0) END AS media_only_cac_gbp
FROM MarketingChannelMonthly GROUP BY marketing_channel, cost_coverage ORDER BY marketing_channel ASC;
direct_sql:
SELECT marketing_channel, cost_coverage, SUM(spend_gbp) AS spend_gbp, SUM(valid_sessions) AS valid_sessions, SUM(attributed_orders) AS attributed_orders, SUM(net_revenue_gbp) AS net_revenue_gbp,
100.0 * SUM(clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS ctr_pct,
SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cpc_gbp,
CASE WHEN cost_coverage = 'platform_media_only' THEN 100.0 * SUM(attributed_orders) / NULLIF(SUM(valid_sessions), 0) END AS conversion_rate_pct,
CASE WHEN cost_coverage = 'platform_media_only' THEN SUM(attributed_net_revenue_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_gbp), 0) END AS net_roas,
CASE WHEN cost_coverage = 'platform_media_only' THEN SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_first_observed_acquisitions), 0) END AS media_only_cac_gbp
FROM "fab_ent"."raw_marts"."mart_marketing__channel_monthly" GROUP BY marketing_channel, cost_coverage ORDER BY marketing_channel ASC;

question: What are overall paid CAC and first-observed acquisitions?
semantic_sql: SELECT SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_first_observed_acquisitions), 0) AS media_only_cac_gbp, SUM(first_observed_acquisitions) AS first_observed_acquisitions, SUM(attributed_first_observed_acquisitions) AS attributed_first_observed_acquisitions, SUM(unattributed_first_observed_acquisitions) AS unattributed_first_observed_acquisitions FROM MarketingMonthlyOverview;
direct_sql: SELECT SUM(spend_gbp) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_first_observed_acquisitions), 0) AS media_only_cac_gbp, SUM(first_observed_acquisitions) AS first_observed_acquisitions, SUM(attributed_first_observed_acquisitions) AS attributed_first_observed_acquisitions, SUM(unattributed_first_observed_acquisitions) AS unattributed_first_observed_acquisitions FROM "fab_ent"."raw_marts"."mart_marketing__monthly_overview";

question: Which month had the strongest net ROAS?
